# Florida Security Concepts

Florida Security Concepts LLC (FSC) repairs, maintains, and installs gates, access control, and cameras for commercial and residential properties. Based in Clermont, Lake County. Same-day when available.

Phone: 352-282-0692
Email: info@floridasecurityconcepts.com
Website: https://www.floridasecurityconcepts.com

## Services

- Security gate systems: slide, swing, barrier-arm, and vertical-lift gates
- Gate repair
- Gate automation and operators
- Maintenance plans, with the visit frequency set per site
- Access control: keypads, credentials, call boxes, and intercoms
- Security camera installation and video surveillance: gate and entry cameras, lots, buildings, recording, retention, and remote viewing, for HOAs, commercial properties, storage, multifamily, and homes
- Security system integration
- Emergency service, available after hours. Call 352-282-0692. Same-day when available. The website form does not dispatch a technician.

An advanced consultation is the way to talk through a property. Submitting the form does not book a visit.
